# Because notes

Notes live in `./blog`, one idea per Markdown file. They publish under `/blog/<file-name>/`.

## The format

```md
---
because: publish        # or "post" for an entry point; notes without it stay private
title: "Heat taxes focus"
date: 2026-10-18        # posts: needed for ordering
---
One short idea, in a few sentences. Plain [[links]] to other notes are fine.

> [!clarify]
> [[answering-note]]

> [!clarify] Custom wording for the question?
> [[another-answer]]
```

- A **question** is a callout whose type is a question kind below. Each `[[link]]` inside it is an answer: another note's file name, without `.md`.
- Only notes with `because: publish` or `because: post` are published, and links to unpublished notes are dropped.
- Keep each note to **one idea**. If a note makes two points, split it and join them with a question.

## Question kinds (Socratic questioning)

| Callout | Default question | When to use it |
|---|---|---|
| `clarify` | What do you mean? | Define a term or narrow the claim. |
| `why` | Why? | The cause or reasoning behind it. |
| `evidence` | What's the evidence? | Data, a study or a source. |
| `whynot` | Why not? | The obvious objection or alternative. |
| `sowhat` | So what? | The consequence. |

## Workflow

1. Read an idea and what surrounds it first: `npx because show <note> --dir ./blog`.
2. Create notes with `npx because new "Title" --dir ./blog` (add `--post` for an entry point), then write the idea.
3. Link with `npx because ask <from-note> <kind> <answer-note> --dir ./blog` (add `--text "Custom wording?"`), or edit the callouts directly.
4. **After every change, run `npx because check --dir ./blog`** and fix what it reports. Warnings (broken links, orphans, unanswered questions) must be fixed. Todos list questions the strategy expects but an idea hasn't asked yet; fill them in where they make the idea stronger.
